name: Auton Valley Berry Farm
tagline: Link to Auton Valley Berry Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Auton
description: Auton Valley Berry Farm is an berry farm in Taylorsville, NC. Visitors come for Blueberries, Blackberries, and Grapes, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
